messages:
sam: Flagging a short thread ahead of tomorrow's roadmap deep-dive. We need a crisp set of launch gates for multi-region tenant slicing + routing policy templates. Trying to avoid scope creep by calling out "must-have" vs "nice-to-have".
anya: love it. product needs a one-liner per gate so sales can triage quickly. also want an "isolation tax" estimate visible in the console.
carmen: engineering view: we can support three policy classes initially: "isolated", "affinity", "shared". each has different packing efficiency and scheduling latency. we should quantify expected GPU overhead per-1000 qps.
todd: ops: add operational gate - evacuation automation verified in staging with a bounded error budget. goal: <1% request error during a simulated live evacuation.
min: infra knobs to surface: prefer_region, fallback_sequence (list), max_cost_uplift_pct, reserved_capacity_commit_days. defaults should bias towards availability.
sam: suggested launch gates (brief):
```
- infra automation: deploy + evac scripts, staged dry-run pass
- telemetry: routing decision + cost attribution emitted per request
- perf: per-tenant p50/p95 targets and regression thresholds defined
- quality: fallback-model regression tests pass against prompt-set v1
- commercial: pricing uplift bands + reserved commit options documented
- legal: residency & egress clause signed for customer
```
anya: small ask: include explicit fallback semantics in the handoff (e.g., allowed fallbacks boolean). sales must be able to state if a customer opts out of fallbacks.
carmen: on the "quantify" bullet: I'll post a short table in the roadmap doc showing GPU_util_delta, avg_queue_latency_delta, and expected cost-per-1M-tokens for each policy class.
todd: ops addendum: require a rollback playbook and a canary plan. rollout pattern: internal -> invited customers (2) -> small cohort (10) -> GA. Each step needs metric gates.
min: telemetry signals we need: slot_allocations, kv_cache_hit_rate, token_cost_usd, chosen_model_variant, fallback_reason, sequence_length_p95. These feed Optimize and billing.
sam: quality guardrails: max_output_deviation_pct = 5 for GA; pilot can accept 8% with explicit customer consent. use prompt-set "onramp-reg-v2".
anya: pricing: finance wants a clear uplift band table. if isolation tax > 18% we aim to offset with reserved discounts. include an example calc in the sales playbook.
legal-bot: reminder: any customer requiring jurisdictional isolation needs a signed DPA addendum and approved egress controls. I'll attach a template.
ops-bot: FYI: scheduled a staging evacuation run Fri 09:00. Will publish logs to #runbooks and tag the playbook PR.
carmen: policy DSL sketch (very small):
```
policy "affinity-v1" {
  prefer_region: true
  allow_fallbacks: true
  fallback_sequence: ["model_variant","capacity_class"]
  reserved_commit_days: 0
}
```
min: note: enforceable guardrails at router: cost_threshold_pct, fallback_timeout_ms, max_seq_length. Router must emit why it picked a fallback.
sam: risk note: strict isolation increases fragmentation and scheduling variance. make sure pricing and SLA language reflect that risk.
anya: action items: 1) carmen to add cost delta table to roadmap doc (Tue), 2) min to PR routing telemetry schema (Wed), 3) todd to run and post evacuation dry-run (Fri), 4) sam/anya to draft sales handoff one-pager (Thu).
sam: ok, keeping this tight for the sync. See you all tomorrow.
